wholePhysicalScope: Named abbey outline and mapped parts, local terrain evidence, parish restoration history, and three exactly matched public-domain Qualla photographs.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the vaulted roof profile, battlements, attached ranges and courtyard arcade.
limitations: Tower height and individual window tracery and masonry joints are approximated from the exterior photographs.
The separately managed detached infirmary and other ruin structures are outside the attached church-and-cloister scope.
